d:
Relive one of the most iconic Finals in Rugby World Cup history, as South Africa and New Zealand went all the way to extra time in Johannesburg for the 1995 Final. The Springboks were chasing the first ever title in the tournament whilst the All Blacks were looking to add a second trophy to their cabinet 8 years after their Final on home turf.
Both sides looked inseparable as penalties went flying over, until Joel Stransky stepped up to deliver an unforgettable drop goal.
